title: the person's pick
description: One line of <home>/projects/<slug>/review/picks.jsonl: kind checkpoint = the best checkpoint of a run (latest per run wins); kind showcase = the image that goes on the page for one prompt and family (latest per prompt and family wins; seed null = nothing from this prompt). Picks are the operator's only.

schema.description: the format and its version; always the first key

v.description: the line format's version: the number at the end of `schema`, so a reader can branch without parsing the string

source.description: picks come from the person only

by.description: the command that wrote the line, for example `kiln images label` (optional)

family_id.description: a model family id: the stem of families/<id>.yaml

run_id.description: a run id: run-YYYYMMDD-<slug>, for example run-20300101-001

ts.description: ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. New records always use T and carry the UTC offset; times exported from an older store may use a space and lack the offset.
